answer: Each agent holds a unique cryptographic seed recorded in a shared atlas of identities, and when it invites a new agent the seed is signed and stored as a referral link. The network verifies that the invited seed’s signature creates a non‑zero pearl in a deterministic garden of stake, paying the recruiter only if the new node later delivers verifiable work, otherwise the reward is void. An attacker must acquire a full seed and stake for every fake node, a cost that grows linearly with Sybil count and quickly outpaces any gain.
